about: Comparing a date or a date and time with an empty one, on every stack (the user, 2026-11-22: "Empty is smallest"): an empty value comes before every value, and two empty ones are equal, so `due < today` is true when due is empty, and `due >= today` false. Each case gives the `kind` (date or datetime), `a` and `b` (null for empty) and what `<`, `<=`, `>` and `>=` give.
